name: studyloop
description: Free STEM study companion with original practice, hints, feedback, and local nickname memory. studyloop.in

scripts.build: node scripts/audit-content-hygiene.mjs && node --max-old-space-size=8192 node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --noEmit -p tsconfig.source.json && node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build && node scripts/ensure-next-pages-manifest.mjs
scripts.build:pages: node scripts/audit-content-hygiene.mjs && node --max-old-space-size=8192 node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --noEmit -p tsconfig.source.json && node scripts/build-pages.mjs
scripts.launch:audit: node scripts/audit-content-hygiene.mjs && node scripts/audit-launch-readiness.mjs && node scripts/audit-educator-regressions.mjs
scripts.audit:deploy: npm run content:inventory && npm run launch:audit && npm run feedback:audit && npm run audit:figures && npm run audit:public-content && npm run audit:cloudflare-free
scripts.preview: node scripts/audit-content-hygiene.mjs && node --max-old-space-size=8192 node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --noEmit -p tsconfig.source.json && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.deploy: npm run audit:deploy && npm run typecheck && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy && pnpm run deploy:verify
scripts.upload: node scripts/audit-content-hygiene.mjs && node --max-old-space-size=8192 node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --noEmit -p tsconfig.source.json && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare upload
scripts.build:cloudflare: node scripts/audit-content-hygiene.mjs && node --max-old-space-size=8192 node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --noEmit -p tsconfig.source.json && opennextjs-cloudflare build
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run audit:deploy && npm run typecheck && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy && pnpm run deploy:verify
scripts.upload:cloudflare: node scripts/audit-content-hygiene.mjs && node --max-old-space-size=8192 node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --noEmit -p tsconfig.source.json && opennextjs-cloudflare upload
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run audit:deploy && npm run typecheck && node scripts/build-pages.mjs && node scripts/audit-cloudflare-free-limits.mjs --out && wrangler pages deploy out --project-name=studyloop2 --branch=main && pnpm run deploy:verify
scripts.deploy:feedback: wrangler deploy --config wrangler.feedback.jsonc && pnpm run deploy:verify
scripts.deploy:verify: node scripts/purge-cloudflare-cache.mjs && node scripts/verify-educator-release.mjs https://studyloop.in && node scripts/verify-educator-release.mjs https://www.studyloop.in && node scripts/verify-educator-release.mjs https://www2.studyloop.in && node scripts/verify-seo-release.mjs
